threads.title: Israel's hung Knesset and coalition talks
threads.summary: Israel held a national election in late October 2026. On 1 November AP News reported that Israeli officials said the results will stand after Netanyahu claimed Arabs stole the vote. Earlier briefs covered a hung parliament and coalition talks. Those details were not in this round's verified facts, so re-verify them before reuse.

last_state.fact: No bloc reached 61 seats; up to 480,000 soldier/diplomat ballots were still being counted
Likud accused Arab parties of fraud without evidence; fact-checkers and election officials disputed it
Herzog consulting party leaders; Netanyahu reportedly wants unity government with Eisenkot

timeline.text: Israeli officials say vote stands after Netanyahu's 'stolen' claim

threads.title: US midterm elections on November 3
threads.summary: The US votes on 3 November 2026 for control of Congress. Republicans hold the Senate 53–47 and the House 218 plus one independent to 214. Democrats need net gains of four Senate and three House seats. Forecasts favour Democrats; Cook rates seven Senate races toss-ups. Over 51 million voted early by 1 November. The Justice Department, on Trump's order, sued to block Alaska's certification if Peltola wins; no ruling found. Trump offered a $1 million fraud-tip reward.

last_state.fact: Early votes by 1 November: more than 51 million
Senate: Republicans 53–47; Democrats need net gain of four
House: Republicans 218 plus one independent, Democrats 214, two vacancies; Democrats need net gain of three
Cook toss-up Senate races: Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, Maine, Michigan, Ohio, Texas
Alaska certification lawsuit: no court ruling found
Trump approval: about 37%

timeline.text: Early votes now exceed 51 million, up from 18 million. New polls from 1 November show Democrats narrowly ahead in six toss-up Senate states, with Nebraska tied.

watch.what: Election Day across the US for control of Congress
First polls close at about 04:30 IST (6 p.m. Eastern on 3 November)

threads.title: Ukraine war: US-Russia talks and aid
threads.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff met Putin on 21 October 2026 with written proposals; Putin offered no ceasefire. A US-brokered six-day local ceasefire in Oleshky (Kherson) began 27 October and ended on the night of 1 November with no violations, while Russian strikes continued elsewhere. Rubio says the US is reviewing Turkish and Indian proposals for a limited Black Sea ceasefire. The WSJ reports the US is pushing to restore Russian gas sales to Europe via Ukraine.

last_state.fact: Putin to study US written proposals after nearly four-hour meeting
Oleshky local ceasefire effective October 27 for aid and evacuations
Zelensky: ~12 Patriot interceptors a month received

timeline.text: Ukraine's six-day Oleshky truce ends quietly; US weighs Black Sea truce

threads.title: Iran Hormuz tanker attacks and oil prices
threads.summary: Ships in Hormuz keep being hit: a Qatari gas tanker on 30 October, a vessel on 1 November. The US blockades Iranian ports. On 31 October Trump named Pickaxe Mountain as a site still to deal with; on 1 November he said the war ends soon, by deal or militarily. Khamenei warned of an immediate response. Araghchi offered a conditional two-day reopening. Rubio said no strike decision has been made. Brent fell about 3% to below $110 on 2 November.

last_state.fact: Brent below $110 on 2 November, down about 3%
Rubio: no decision on resuming military action against Iran
Araghchi: Hormuz can reopen in two days if US lifts blockade, frees assets, waives oil sanctions
No direct US–Iran talks planned; Iran using mediators
Iran's Supreme Leader is Mojtaba Khamenei
Ships still hit: Qatari gas tanker on 30 October, a vessel on 1 November

timeline.text: New since the last edition: Trump named Pickaxe Mountain as a site still to deal with. Iran offered to reopen Hormuz in two days on conditions. Rubio said no strike decision has been made. Brent fell about 3% to below $1

threads.title: France cost-of-living protests and strikes
threads.summary: France has seen repeated mass protest days in autumn 2026. On 31 October more than 300,000 people marched, some in Halloween costumes. The largely peaceful day ended with police clashing with masked rioters, which the New York Times described as clashes erupting again. Earlier briefs mentioned causes, arrest counts and a planned general strike. Those were not in this round's verified facts, so re-verify them.

last_state.fact: 400,000+ marched; nearly 1,000 arrests
General strike planned Nov 5

timeline.text: Over 300,000 march across France; day ends in clashes

threads.title: Spain Toledo train crash
threads.summary: On October 28, 2026, a Renfe high-speed train rear-ended a stopped Iryo train near Toledo. The death toll reached at least 68, including former minister Fátima Báñez, with over 100 injured. Iryo says rail operator ADIF ordered the halt over a signal fault and called the order inexplicable.

last_state.fact: At least 68 dead, 100+ injured
Iryo blames ADIF halt order

threads.title: DRC Ebola outbreak, worst ever
threads.summary: The Ebola outbreak in DRC, ongoing since May 2026, passed 10,000 confirmed cases and nearly 4,900 deaths by October 31, across eight provinces. It has spread to Kenya and Nigeria, with Nigeria's first case confirmed October 20.

last_state.fact: More than 10,000 cases, nearly 4,900 deaths
Kenya confirmed nine cases; Nigeria also has cases

threads.title: Protests against India's Election Commission
threads.summary: Opposition and civil groups are protesting the Election Commission's voter-roll revision (SIR), demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar resign over alleged skewing of the 2025 Bihar revision. Protesters were detained near the EC's Delhi office on October 23; protests are planned in 88 cities through November 1.

last_state.fact: Protesters detained near EC office in Delhi
Protests in 88 cities through Nov 1

threads.title: Cyclone Arnab hits India's east coast
threads.summary: A Bay of Bengal depression became Cyclone Arnab and made landfall near Yanam, Andhra Pradesh, around October 28, 2026, with winds up to 150 km/h. Over 180,000 people were evacuated across Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. At least three deaths and flooding were reported; recovery continues.

last_state.fact: Landfall near Yanam, winds to 150 km/h; 180,000+ evacuated; at least 3 dead

On 2 November reports said UPI crossed 25 billion transactions in October for the first time. Those payments were worth ₹31.53 lakh crore, and festive spending was credited for the record.

threads.title: Fed rate path under chair Warsh
threads.summary: The Fed held rates at 3.75%-4.00% on October 28, 2026, at new chair Kevin Warsh's first meeting, after a September hike. The vote was 10-2, with Cook and Hammack wanting a hike (another report said officials wanted a cut). Markets are pricing a possible December move.

last_state.fact: Markets pricing a possible December move

Alphabet fell about 10% after missing profit estimates and raising 2026 capex to $205B despite Cloud growth. Microsoft's Azure grew 48%. Amazon reports October 29; Apple reports November 2.

Microsoft Azure up 48%

Verstappen won for Red Bull and is now second in the standings. Hamilton was runner-up and called for 'serious talks' at Ferrari after a first-lap clash with Leclerc. Watch Ferrari's response.

threads.summary: India won the five-match T20I series in New Zealand 3-2 after leading 3-0. New Zealand took the last two games, including the fifth T20I in Hamilton, which they won by seven wickets behind Seifert and Phillips. Kishan and Iyer added 93 off 43 balls in that game. Earlier briefs mentioned the captaincy, injuries and ODI selection. Re-verify those details.

last_state.fact: India 2-0 up in T20I series
Kishan out injured; Sooryavanshi considered

threads.title: North Korea-linked hackers steal $6.3 billion from Binance, FBI says
threads.summary: On 29 October 2026, hackers stole $6.3 billion in tokens from Binance, which paused withdrawals. Co-CEO Richard Teng described an attack involving a compromised laptop and malware meant to delete evidence. The FBI blamed North Korea's TraderTraitor, also blamed for the $1.5 billion Bybit theft in February 2025. Binance says it absorbs the loss, has replaced 90% and published a 1:1 proof-of-reserves snapshot. It expected to reopen withdrawals on 1 November.

last_state.fact: Amount stolen from Binance: $6.3 billion, on 29 October 2026
FBI attribution: North Korea, activity labelled TraderTraitor
Share of loss replaced by Binance: 90%
Binance says it, not users, absorbs the loss
Binance proof of reserves: at least 1:1 backing
Binance co-CEO: Richard Teng

timeline.text: Binance says the attack involved a compromised laptop, and the FBI blames North Korea. Binance says it is paying for the loss itself, so customer balances are still backed.

watch.what: Binance expected to reopen customer withdrawals

threads.title: Nature summit agrees Yerevan Pathway, but leaves money questions open
threads.summary: COP17 in Yerevan (19–31 October 2026) adopted the Yerevan Pathway, setting priorities to 2030 after a review found the world off track on the Kunming-Montreal framework's 23 targets. Nearly $2 billion pledged against a $700 billion yearly gap. Cali Fund holds about $10,000; its design deferred two years. Post-2030 finance mechanism choice deferred to COP18, Ecuador, 2028. French minister Monique Barbut called it 'not commensurate' with the crisis; WWF called it a step forward but weak on subsidies.

last_state.fact: Yerevan Pathway adopted: 31 October 2026
COP18 host: Ecuador, 2028
CBD Executive Secretary: Astrid Schomaker
Protected: about 19% of land and inland waters, 10% of oceans; goal 30%
New pledges at COP17: nearly $2 billion
Cali Fund balance: about $10,000

timeline.text: Countries agreed priorities to 2030, including phasing out nature-harmful subsidies and more money for poorer nations. But the world is off track, pledges are small, and big finance decisions moved to 2028.

watch.what: COP18 in Ecuador decides the post-2030 finance mechanism (exact date not given)
Deadline for the framework's 23 targets, including 30x30
